note: One record per consulted public source. A URL record preserves the consulted occurrence and claim boundary; it is not a local snapshot of the source bytes. Multiple pages from one author/site share one evidence lineage.

artifacts.title: Hara Museum collection exhibition press release
artifacts.information: The museum building in Gotenyama was constructed in 1938 as businessman Kunizo Hara's residence.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: Direct for Kunizo Hara's Gotenyama property/residence context; not evidence that Itsuko was his daughter or that she lived there.

artifacts.title: Hara Museum facility record
artifacts.information: The museum reused the former Hara residence built in 1938 at Kitashinagawa 4-7-25, with access from the Gotenyama bus stop.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: Direct for building date and municipal location; does not name Kunizo in the descriptive body and does not prove kinship.

artifacts.title: Hara Residence / current Hara Museum
artifacts.information: The residence was built in 1938 in Gotenyama for businessman Kunizo Hara.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: Independent direct support for the property/context claim; no Itsuko kinship information.

artifacts.title: Takasago Thermal Engineering 100-year history, data volume
artifacts.information: The 1973 shareholder table lists Matsui Itsuko / 松井以都子 with 354,500 shares alongside several Hara-named shareholders; the chronology identifies Kunizo Hara as company founder and records his 1958 death.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: Direct for the married-name occurrence and corporate association; indirect only for Hara-family affiliation and not proof of parentage or marriage.

artifacts.title: Takasago Thermal Engineering Co., Ltd. 70-year history catalog record
artifacts.information: The catalog description identifies Kunizo Hara as 1883-1958 and as the founder of Takasago Kogyo in 1916.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: Direct for public biographical context; no evidence for the Itsuko parent-child edge.

artifacts.title: Kazoku Meibo, surveyed 20 May 1940
artifacts.publisher: Kazoku Kaikan; digitized by the National Diet Library
artifacts.information: A targeted public-source audit reported a Matsui household entry naming wife 以都子 with a Taisho 5 birth year.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: Promising near-primary spouse lead only. Root confirmed the volume and scanned its 170 IIIF pages with Japanese OCR but did not independently recover the decisive entry; page number and visual reading remain required. It supplies no maiden surname or parentage.
artifacts.snapshot_status: catalog_and_iiif_manifest_verified; decisive_page_unverified; source bytes not committed

artifacts.title: Hara Rokuro / Kunizo Hara lineage article
artifacts.information: Calls Itsuko / 以都子 Kunizo Hara's third daughter and says she married Akira, eldest son of Baron Keishiro Matsui.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: Discovery lead; same author/lineage as the Matsui article and contradicted by that article's fifth-daughter wording.

artifacts.title: Keishiro and Akira Matsui lineage article
artifacts.information: Names Akira's wife as Itsuko / 以都子, born 1916 in Tokyo, and calls her Kunizo Hara's fifth daughter.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: Discovery lead; not independent from the Hara article and internally contradicted on daughter ordinal.

artifacts.title: Matsui family lineage page
artifacts.information: Names Akira's wife as Hara Itsuko / 原以都子, born 1916, and describes her as Kunizo Hara's daughter.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: Independent modern secondary repetition, but not primary proof and no daughter ordinal is established.

artifacts.title: Hara Kunizo
artifacts.publisher: Edited by Bon Shiraishi; published by Taki Hara; cataloged by CiNii Books
artifacts.information: Catalog record for a 1960 family-published biography of Kunizo Hara.
artifacts.evidence_assessment: High-value finite proof lane; the catalog proves the book exists, not that its unseen contents name Itsuko.
